_note: Download sources. HF ids come from Hugging Face API search results on 2026-11-11 (not each page opened). Ollama pages for the models we pulled. 'official' = published under the model maker's own namespace.

trusted_gguf_publishers.unsloth: widely used GGUF and dynamic quants, fast to publish new models
trusted_gguf_publishers.lmstudio-community: LM Studio team GGUF and MLX builds
trusted_gguf_publishers.bartowski: long-running GGUF quantizer with imatrix builds
trusted_gguf_publishers.mradermacher: large catalogue of GGUF and imatrix GGUF quants
trusted_gguf_publishers.mlx-community: Apple MLX conversions (also lmstudio-community MLX builds)

caution_publishers: Abliterated/uncensored/'heretic' builds (huihui-ai, HauhauCS, DavidAU, eriktonon and similar) are unvetted community edits; review before relying on them.

gemma4:12b-it-q4_K_M.note: No official 12B GGUF found in search; google publishes QAT GGUF for E4B (google/gemma-4-E4B-it-qat-q4_0-gguf).

gemma4:12b-it-qat.note: 12B QAT GGUF repo not found in search.

qwen3.6:35b-a3b-q4_K_M.note: No official Qwen GGUF repo found; Qwen publishes FP8 (Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8).

granite4:32b-a9b-h.note: Mapping to 'h-small' inferred from matching size on Ollama (19 GB).

granite4:7b-a1b-h.note: Mapping to 'h-tiny' inferred from matching size on Ollama (4.2 GB).

hir0rameel/qwen-claude:latest.note: Community Ollama upload; no Hugging Face repo found for this author.

eriktonon/gemma4-uncensored:latest.note: Community Ollama upload; no Hugging Face repo found for this author. Base: Gemma 4.

eriktonon/qwen3.6-moe-uncensored:latest.note: Community Ollama upload; no Hugging Face repo found for this author. Base: Qwen 3.6 35B-A3B.
